attestations.note: The page heads him «(; - 1740)» and then says it has nothing: «Δεν έχουμε λεπτομέρειες για τον βίο του Ρώσου Αγίου.» It links him to the Synaxis of all the Saints of Siberia and gives no hymn. The see and the year of death are the whole of the record.

death.note: saint.gr heads him «Αγιος Αντωνιος Μητροπολιτης Τομπολσκ (; - 1740)». The year is in the page's heading only; the body of the page says it has no details of his life, so nothing corroborates the year on the page itself.
